LanguageData.USAC_ScenarioDebtStart.label: The Debt Squad
LanguageData.USAC_ScenarioDebtStart.description: Four people bound by USAC contracts hit atmosphere in a failing line of drop pods: a debt inheritor, a laid-off mech technician, a former security hand, and a frontier laborer who signed every waiver put in front of them. None of them were meant to lead a colony. All of them were built to survive hard terms. On this rimworld, a contract means nothing unless you can defend it.
